items.title: Why Is Gilead Sciences (GILD) Widening Lenacapavir Access Across 120 Countries?
items.summary: Gilead Sciences (NasdaqGS:GILD) expanded its royalty-free voluntary licensing of once-yearly lenacapavir for HIV prevention to 120 high-incidence countries. items.title: Gilead Expands Lenacapavir Licensing Agreements to Include Once-Yearly HIV Prevention Formulation
items.summary: Gilead Sciences (NASDAQ:GILD) has expanded six existing royalty-free voluntary licensing agreements to include an investigational once-yearly formulation of lenacapavir for HIV prevention, the company announced. The expanded agreements cover 120 countries with high HIV incidence, primarily low- and lower-middle-income nations.
